notes.rubric_reuse: Process trajectories in deterministic case_cursor/case_id/leaf_id order. Match each trajectory against the latest working KEEP bank. Reuse an equivalent criterion without generator, Gate, or rerun calls; otherwise generate, Gate, and witness-check it, adding only KEEP immediately before the next trajectory.
notes.scoring: After every trajectory transaction, freeze the final working bank for the five-case batch and score every bank criterion with shared-state applicability. Final scoring has no top-k cutoff.
